challenges.name: retry-backoff-jitter
challenges.title: Fix the gateway retry loop
challenges.description: Rice Rocket's order-status poller asks the payment gateway about 300 pending orders. During a five-minute gateway outage its retry helper made things worse: all 300 pollers retried in lockstep every second and knocked the gateway over again as it came back, `400 order not found` answers were retried until the attempts ran out, a request kept retrying after its deadline, and a cancelled request went on calling the gateway in the background. The editor holds `retry.py` with the repaired helper's key blocks missing, each marked by a `# [ ]` line; the wrong pieces are the old helper's code. Fill every line so that `call_with_retry` retries only TimeoutError, ConnectionError and HTTP 429/502/503/504, waits `rng.uniform(0, min(cap, base * 2 ** attempt))` (Retry-After as a minimum), never sleeps past the deadline, never swallows cancellation, and finally raises the last error. Run plays single calls, a 300-poller outage and a cancellation on asyncio's clock.
hints: Take the symptoms one by one: which line decides what gets retried, which decides how long to wait, and which one should look at the clock before sleeping?
Look at the exception classes in the `except` clauses (and what `BaseException` also catches), `rng.uniform` with `base * 2 ** attempt`, and comparing `loop.time() + delay` with the give-up time.

A retry helper for an S3 upload looks like: `except (TimeoutError, ConnectionError)` and `except ClientError` with a status check that re-raises 4xx; `delay = rng.uniform(0, min(20, 0.2 * 2 ** attempt))`; `if loop.time() + delay > give_up_at: break`; after the loop, `raise last`.

tests.name: Timeouts, a reset and a 503, then success: retried with jittered backoff
400 order not found is raised at once, never retried
429 with Retry-After: 3 waits at least 3 seconds before trying again
With a 6 s deadline the helper gives up instead of sleeping past it
300 pollers through a 5 s outage: spread out, no wave when the gateway is back
A cancelled request stops and never calls the gateway again
